They’re back and topped with grilled, marinated steak, Creamy Jalapeño sauce, Nacho Cheese sauce, & sliced pickled jalapeño heat.

Order Now

At participating US Taco Bell® locations for a limited time only, while supplies last. Contact store for price and participation which varies. Tax extra.

Mini Gets Elevated

The Flamin’ Hot® Mini Taco Salad is a limited-time must-have on the Luxe Value Menu.

Order Now

At participating U.S. Taco Bell® locations for a limited time only, while supplies last. Contact store for price and participation, which vary. Tax extra.

Your Cravings. You Call the Shots.

Customize a Build Your Own Luxe Box with premium upgrades and new additions like the Crunchy Taco Supreme®.

Order Now

At participating US Taco Bell® locations for a limited time only, while supplies last. Contact store for price and participation which varies. Drinks exclude specialty beverages. Selections made from predetermined menu items. Crunchy Taco Supreme®, Soft Taco Supreme® or a Regular Freeze can be upgraded for $1. Product packaging may vary. Other exclusions apply. Tax extra. Must be a Registered Taco Bell Rewards Member. Taco Bell Rewards Program is available at participating locations subject to terms and conditions, wherein points are earned on qualifying purchases while supplies last: Terms and conditions.

Luxe However You Like

Go for the $5 Classic, $7 Supreme, or $9 Discovery Luxe Box®. Each transcends every flavor expectation.

Explore Menu

At participating US Taco Bell® locations for a limited time only, while supplies last. Contact store for price and participation which varies. Drinks exclude Freezes and specialty beverages. Product packaging may vary. Other exclusions apply. Tax extra. All trademarks are the property of their respective owners.

What's Happening On the App

Our First-Ever Open

Live Más Open is coming. Before the stream, you can play a digital version of the Open on the app for rewards, featuring a surprise from DoorDash.

New Drops Arrive Every Tuesday

Exclusive offers, experiences, and opportunities for Rewards Members.◊

Choose Your Free Reward

Your free reward awaits on our app. All it takes is you joining Taco Bell Rewards.°

◊Rewards and offers subject to change at any time. Taco Bell® Rewards Program is available at participating U.S. locations and subject to Terms and conditions.

°Free-sign-up reward valid for 14 days from issuance and redeemable only via the Taco Bell mobile app for in-store/drive-thru pickup orders, at participating U.S. Taco Bell® locations, while supplies last. Not available for a web pay-ahead, pickup order or delivery order. Must be a registered Taco Bell app user in order to redeem. Reward valid once per registered user. No product or ingredient substitutions, upgrades or add-ons. Reward is non-transferable and cannot be combined with any other offer. No cash value. Terms and conditions apply.

News to Know

Olivia Rodrigo x Taco Bell®

Try Olivia Rodrigo’s Pretty Pink Baja Blast® before it’s gone.1

New Café. ​ Same Taco Bell. ​

Your new fave café is inside a Taco Bell. Treat yourself to one of 20+ deliciously surprising beverages.​

Let’s Be Honest They Want a Gift Card

Check out our various Gift Card designs for any occasion on your list.■

We're Hiring.

Working for Taco Bell just hits different®. Join our family today.‡

1Available at participating locations for a limited time, while supplies last (incl cup). Packaging may vary. Price and participation may vary. Tax extra. Mountain Dew, the Mountain Dew Logo and Baja Blast are trademarks of PepsiCo, Inc. ©2026 Taco Bell IP Holder, LLC.

■Gift Cards are redeemable at participating US Taco Bell® locations. No expiration date and no fees apply to Gift Card balances. See complete terms and conditions at terms and conditions. Issued by GCTB, LLC ©2026 Taco Bell IP Holder, LLC.

‡For corporate and franchise locations. Franchisees and licensees are independent business owners and employers and are responsible for their own employment practices and benefits.
